title: Windows Server ISO Updater - wsusscn2 servicing dependency database (Layer 2)
description: Authoritative machine-readable contract for data/servicing-dependency-database.json. This is the implemented '_meta + updates' camelCase shape and is the single source of truth for the Layer 2 document shape, superseding the historical prose sketch in SPEC B.19.10.1-B.19.10.4 (the deprecated 'Packages'/'RevisionIndex'/PascalCase draft). Cross-cutting data-quality is governed by the shared sub-project data contract (_meta.dataContractId + _meta.dataContractVersion), not by an independent per-model schema version. Servicing-stack fields (requiredServicingStackVersion / providedServicingStackVersion / servicingStackModel) and kbIds are defined here as the target shape; they are populated by the wsusscn2 analysis step (M1) via per-package CBS metadata extraction. Provenance is portable: sourceCab carries sourceUrl (the canonical CDN URL) and never a local filesystem path; the recency evaluation timestamp is _meta.scope.evaluatedAt.

dataContractId.description: Stable GUID identifying this sub-project's data-contract family. Stamped identically into every data artifact (Layer 1 config-Server*.json and this Layer 2 file) from the single Script-side constant. A foreign or unrecognised value marks the artifact as not belonging to this sub-project.

dataContractVersion.description: Shared cross-cutting data-contract epoch held by the Script as the single source of truth and stamped into every data artifact. Bumped on any breaking shape change to any data model so all artifacts move in lockstep; one comparison validates the whole set. Supersedes the retired per-model schema versions (config v2.1, Layer 2 unversioned).

scriptVersion.description: Code version identifier of the generating script. Distinct from dataContractVersion (which versions the data shape, not the code).

scriptTag.description: Code tag of the generating script.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this document was written.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical CDN URL of the wsusscn2.cab the parse derived from. Portable provenance; replaces the non-portable local filesystem 'path' that earlier versions committed.

size.description: Size of the source wsusscn2.cab in bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the source wsusscn2.cab (provenance anchor).

productGuids.description: Allow-list of supported Server OS Product GUIDs used as the scope filter (allow-overrides). See SPEC B.19.7 / B.19.7.1.

classificationGuids.description: Update Classification GUIDs admitted into scope.

recencyMonths.description: Recency window in months used at parse time. Supported policy settings are 24 (default), 36, and -1 (disabled); enforced by the scope-invariants gate, not by this shape schema.

evaluatedAt.description: Timestamp the recency window was evaluated against (the parser 'now'). Renamed from the earlier ambiguous 'now' field.

eosEsuBundlesExcluded.description: Count of EOS/ESU deny-only bundles excluded by the deny-list with a warning. Populated by the wsusscn2 analysis step (M1, SPEC B.19.7.1, warned-exclusion policy).

updates.description: In-scope bundle updates with resolved payload URLs.

updateId.description: Lowercase UpdateId GUID of the bundle (or null when absent in the source).

revisionId.description: RevisionId integer, carried as a string.

creationDate.description: ISO-8601 CreationDate, or null when the source omitted it.

prerequisiteUpdateIds.description: <Prerequisites><UpdateId> values from the Master XML. These are applicability / detectoid GUIDs, NOT install-order prerequisites (SPEC B.19.13 Phase 2c correction).

kbIds.description: KB numbers (numeric, no 'KB' prefix) recovered from the kb(\d+) token in payloadUrls and persisted for direct presence lookup. Populated by the wsusscn2 analysis step (M1).

requiredServicingStackVersion.description: Minimum servicing-stack version this LCU requires, read from its per-package CBS installerAssembly (name='Microsoft-Windows-ServicingStack'). Present for SSU-separate OSes (Server 2016 / 2019); null for combined (2022) and checkpoint (2025) models where the SSU travels inside the LCU. Populated by M1 (SPEC B.19.13).

providedServicingStackVersion.description: Servicing-stack version the configured SSU supplies; null when no separate SSU applies. Populated by M1.

servicingStackModel.description: Servicing-stack delivery model for this update's OS family (research B.19.13 / B.19.7.2): 'separate' (2016/2019), 'combined' (2022), 'checkpoint' (2025). Populated by M1.
